title: Software Engineer - Python and K8s
description:
Overview

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing. Our mission is to reinvent the way companies manage their open source information systems - on public clouds and in their own data centers. To achieve that we are building a new community around Python opscode for open source applications, running on Kubernetes. We want to move all of Canonical and Ubuntu IS onto this new open source codebase. We are confident that we can dramatically improve the experience of running complex business operations - and then we can help our customers embrace those new techniques and products. Traditionally, IS is an inward-facing operation. We would like to transform our IS team into an extension of the product engineering capability at Canonical. Our internal workloads are in many cases the same open source workloads that our customers want to operate. This team will productize those workloads for real-time automated operations on Kubernetes. This role is ideal for software engineers who enjoy Python, have a passion for distributed systems, and an interest in the entire Linux stack - from kernel to networking to virtualization and containers. It is a role that requires rigor in both code and customer interactions. Our engineers are technically astute open source enthusiasts who are excited about cloud computing and are ready to join a global team charged with delivering world class services to our customers.

Responsibilities
  • Work in Python to design and deliver open source software operations code
  • Work across the entire Linux stack, from kernel, networking, storage, to applications
  • Learn to think rigorously about application and infrastructure reliability
  • Shape high quality open source monitoring and alerting infrastructure
  • Simplify open source operations for our customers and open source community
  • Demonstrate sound engineering design and testing principles in your code
  • Follow agile software development practices
  • Coach and develop your colleagues where you have insights
  • Grow a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with company values
  • Work from home with global travel once or twice a year for up to 2 weeks for events
What we are looking for in you
  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
  • You are experienced with Linux systems administration, package management, and operations
  • You have hands-on experience with at least one public cloud
  • You are familiar with Docker and Kubernetes
  • You are an experienced Python programmer and enjoy challenging projects
  • You understand the importance of reliable software and strive to design and code to that expectation
  • You are organized and want your team to deliver timely, high quality software
What we offer colleagues
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

  • Familiarity with MLflow, Feature Store, and Databricks Model Serving.
  • DataOps/CI-CD for notebooks and IaC (Terraform, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions).

  • Experience with transactional data systems and stacks, such as Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, SQL Server, Postgres, MongoDB, as well as microservices, message queues, actor-models, event-driven architectures, etc.

Overview

Role: Software Engineer (Python/Linux/Packaging) at Canonical. Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We design and maintain specialist Python tools to support the developer build and publication process. The team takes responsibility for tooling that builds snaps, charms and more recently, rocks.

Snapcraft allows developers to deliver app updates to millions of Linux systems automatically, eliminating the long tail of supported releases and complex install instructions. Snapcraft enables thousands of applications from over a thousand developers, including well-recognised names like Spotify, Slack, and Microsoft.

Likewise, Charmcraft enables collaboration between charmed operator developers, and publication on Charmhub, home of the Charmed Operator Collection. Charmed Operators enable developers to package software like databases, event queues, caches, observability tools, identity tools and more, right alongside the operations code that enables teams to integrate and operate that software at scale from Day 0 to Day 1,000, and beyond.

And Rockcraft provides the means for container developers to build production-grade Ubuntu-based container images, regardless of their experience as a software developer. These container images are called Rocks and can be found in various popular container registries, like Docker Hub, offering an opinionated and consistent design that focus on security while providing an homogeneous user experience across all rocks.

What we are looking for in you
  • You have expertise in Python.
  • You have a strong understanding of the makeup of a modern GNU/Linux distribution.
  • You have a good understanding of build systems and toolchains, including for cross-compilation.
  • Experience working with container technology, such as Docker, Kubernetes and LXD.
  • Use your familiarity with languages, toolchains, frameworks, integrations, and CI systems to extend the snap build ecosystem

Descrição da vaga

Somos a PRIO, a maior companhia independente de óleo e gás do Brasil. Buscamos continuamente por otimização de processos operacionais e de soluções inovadoras que visem diminuir os custos. Aqui todo trabalho é multidisciplinar e cada desafio é único!

Estamos buscando um Técnico de Instrumentação III para integrar nosso time offshore.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Executar a manutenção diária e o comissionamento de sistemas e equipamentos de instrumentação pneumática, eletrônica e de controle aplicados às operações de produção, atuando em sistemas DCS, PLC, redes de comunicação, sistemas pneumáticos, válvulas de controle e de ESD, posicionadores, instrumentos de temperatura, pressão, vazão e nível, incluindo medidores baseados em réguas, gabaritos, visores, boias, diferencial de pressão e ondas ultrassônicas, além de sistemas de incêndio, detecção de gás, medição de processo e fiscal;
  • Realizar a calibração, testes, parametrização e diagnóstico com uso de ferramentas e softwares especializados, com conhecimento avançado em configurador HART, assegurando a confiabilidade, a disponibilidade e a segurança das operações conforme normas e procedimentos da indústria;
  • Realizar a calibração de instrumentos tais como manômetros, termômetros, transmissores eletrônicos de pressão e temperatura, entre outros;
  • Executar a instalação, manutenção corretiva, preventiva e preditiva, calibração e reparação de todos os instrumentos necessários na área de Instrumentação da Unidade Marítima, com foco nos sistemas de combate a incêndio e de emergência, para garantir a correta operação da Unidade de acordo com as metas operacionais e de QSMS (Qualidade, Segurança, Meio Ambiente e Saúde) vigentes.

Requisitos e qualificações

Formação acadêmica:

  • Técnico completo.

Experiência prévia desejada:

  • Ferramenta SAP;
  • Experiência com sistema de fogo e gás, sistema de controle, válvulas de atuadores, posicionadores e atuadores de válvula;
  • Experiência em sistemas de geração de energia;
  • Experiência em turbomáquinas (LM2500).

Informações adicionais

Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO?

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas!

Dica: Nesse nosso papo, vamos querer saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você consiga nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado!

Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, aonde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:

  • Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;
  • Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;
  • Acesses nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!
  • Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.

Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!

Venha fazer parte da PRIO

Somos a PRIO, a maior companhia independente de óleo e gás do Brasil. Buscamos continuamente por otimização de processos operacionais e de soluções inovadoras que visem diminuir os custos. Aqui todo trabalho é multidisciplinar e cada desafio é único!

Com foco no investimento e na recuperação de ativos em produção, somos especializados na gestão eficiente de reservatórios e no redesenvolvimento de campos maduros. Acreditamos na condução dos negócios, com foco em segurança e cuidado com a saúde dos seus colaboradores.

Nosso ambiente de trabalho

Oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e com muitas oportunidades de participação em diferentes projetos, favorecendo o desenvolvimento profissional e o crescimento do time. Trabalhamos em um escritório open space , o que permite a integração entre todas as equipes e a Diretoria, onde todos podem participar da tomada de decisões.

Nossa cultura busca o alto desempenho e a participação efetiva de todas as pessoas. Se você sonha em se desenvolver junto com uma empresa em constante crescimento, venha fazer parte do nosso time!

description:
Overview

As The Discovery and Conversion Company, our mission is to connect consumers with the world’s leading brands through data-driven content and technology.

Headquartered in South Florida with a remote-first team spanning over 15 countries, we’ve built a high-growth, high-performance culture where speed, ownership, and measurable impact drive success.

WHY JOIN US?

At Launch Potato, you’ll accelerate your career by owning outcomes, moving fast, and driving impact with a global team of high-performers.

We convert audience attention into action through data, machine learning, and continuous optimization.

We’re hiring a Machine Learning Engineer (Recommendation Systems) to build the personalization engine behind our portfolio of brands. You’ll design, deploy, and scale ML systems that power real-time recommendations across millions of user journeys. This role gives you the chance to work on systems serving 100M+ predictions daily, directly impacting engagement, retention, and revenue at scale.

MUST HAVE

You’ve shipped large-scale ML systems into production that power personalization at scale. You’re fluent in ranking algorithms and know how to turn data into engagement and conversions. Specifically:

  • 7+ years building and scaling production ML systems with measurable business impact
  • Strong background in ranking algorithms (collaborative filtering, learning-to-rank, deep learning)
  • Proficiency with Python and ML frameworks (TensorFlow or PyTorch)
  • Skilled with SQL and modern data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift) plus data lakes
  • Familiarity with distributed computing (Spark, Ray) and LLM/AI Agent frameworks
  • Track record of improving business KPIs via ML-powered personalization
  • Experience with A/B testing platforms and experiment logging best practices
YOUR ROLE

Your mission: Drive business growth by building and optimizing the recommendation systems that personalize experience for millions of users daily. You’ll own the modeling, feature engineering, data pipelines, and experimentation that make personalization smarter, faster, and more impactful.

OUTCOMES
  • Build and deploy ML models serving 100M+ predictions per day to personalize user experiences at scale
  • Enhance data processing pipelines (Spark, Beam, Dask) with efficiency and reliability improvements
  • Design ranking algorithms that balance relevance, diversity, and revenue
  • Deliver real-time personalization with latency <50ms across key product surfaces
  • Run statistically rigorous A/B tests to measure true business impact
  • Optimize for latency, throughput, and cost efficiency in production
  • Partner with product, engineering, and analytics to launch high-impact personalization features
  • Implement monitoring systems and maintain clear ownership for model reliability
COMPETENCIES
  • Technical Mastery: You know ML architecture, deployment, and tradeoffs inside out
  • Experimentation Infrastructure: You set up systems for rapid testing and retraining (MLflow, W&B)
  • Impact-Driven: You design models that move revenue, retention, or engagement
  • Collaborative: You thrive working with engineers, PMs, and analysts to scope features
  • Analytical Thinking: You break down data trends and design rigorous test methodologies
  • Ownership Mentality: You own your models post-deployment and continuously improve them
  • Execution-Oriented: You deliver production-grade systems quickly without sacrificing rigor
  • Curious & Innovative: You stay on top of ML advances and apply them to personalization

Want to accelerate your career? Apply now!

We are an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and value diversity, equity, and inclusion. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other legally protected characteristics.

Trabalhar na Proper Marine é integrar uma equipe multidisciplinar altamente qualificada, com foco em excelência técnica, inovação e segurança. Nosso ambiente estimula a troca de conhecimento, o desenvolvimento contínuo e a entrega de soluções eficientes, com espaço para autonomia, criatividade e crescimento profissional.

Formação e experiência:

  • Curso Técnico completo em Projetos Mecânicos, Tubulação, Mecânica, Engenharia Naval ou áreas afins.

  • Desejável formação complementar em Engenharia ou cursos de especialização em tubulação industrial/naval.

  • Registro no CREA (para técnicos ou tecnólogos).

  • Experiência mínima de 5 anos atuando como projetista de tubulação em ambientes navais, offshore ou óleo & gás.

  • Vivência com projetos de sistemas complexos de tubulação a bordo de FPSOs, embarcações de apoio marítimo, sondas, plataformas fixas ou módulos industriais.

Principais responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Desenvolver e revisar modelos 3D de tubulação usando ferramentas específicas (AutoCAD Plant 3D, E3D, PDMS, Navisworks).

  • Elaborar isométricos, desenhos ortogonais, layouts e listas de materiais (BOM/MTO).

  • Realizar roteamento de linhas considerando espaço, interferências, suporte, manutenção e acessibilidade.

  • Participar de revisões de projeto (model review) com equipes multidisciplinares, propondo soluções de engenharia.

  • Garantir que os desenhos estejam em conformidade com os P&IDs, normas de classe e diretrizes do projeto.

  • Verificar interferências e colisões (clash detection) junto às disciplinas de estrutura, elétrica e instrumentação.

  • Preparar documentação técnica de apoio à fabricação e montagem.

  • Colaborar com engenheiros e coordenadores de projeto na definição de especificações e padrões técnicos.

  • Apoiar na compatibilização de disciplinas e interface com fornecedores e estaleiros quando necessário.

Habilidades Técnicas (Hard Skills):

  • Domínio em ferramentas de modelagem e detalhamento de tubulação:

  • AutoCAD Plant 3D, E3D, PDMS, Navisworks, SmartPlant ou equivalentes.

  • Leitura e interpretação de diagramas de processo (P&ID), fluxogramas, plantas e cortes.

  • Conhecimento em:

  • Materiais e classes de tubulação (carbono, inox, duplex, cobre-níquel etc.)

  • Componentes de sistemas de tubulação: válvulas, flanges, suportes, juntas de expansão, etc.

  • Normas e códigos aplicáveis: ASME B31.3 / B31.1, API, NORSOK, ISO, NR-13, entre outros.

  • Noções de cálculo de suportação e esforço, embora não seja um cargo de engenharia.

  • Experiência com sistemas típicos de embarcações e offshore, como:

  • Sistemas de lastro, incêndio, ar-condicionado, combustível, ar comprimido, água potável e esgoto.

  • Familiaridade com práticas de projeto naval, requisitos de classe (DNV, ABS, BV).

  • Inglês técnico para leitura de normas, especificações e comunicação com equipes globais.

Habilidades Comportamentais (Soft Skills):

  • Atenção aos detalhes: compromisso com qualidade, precisão e conformidade técnica.

  • Organização: capacidade de gerenciar múltiplos entregáveis com eficiência.

  • Comunicação clara: para dialogar com equipes internas, engenheiros, fornecedores e estaleiros.

  • Trabalho em equipe: colaboração ativa com diferentes disciplinas.

  • Proatividade: iniciativa para propor melhorias técnicas e identificar possíveis inconsistências de projeto.

  • Flexibilidade e adaptabilidade: agilidade para lidar com alterações de escopo e prazos apertados.

  • Comprometimento com prazos e excelência técnica.

Se você tem experiência sólida em projetos de tubulação naval e quer atuar em uma empresa global com foco em engenharia de ponta, segurança e inovação, essa vaga é para você!

Líder de Segurança do Trabalho - Onshore

Job type: Full-time employee Full-time employee

Se você tem experiência com segurança operacional, meio ambiente e conformidade regulatória de operações offshore, a Karoon Energy quer te conhecer! Buscamos um(a) Líder de Segurança do Trabalho para atuar liderando ações e políticas de segurança do trabalho e saúde, e apoiar em atividades de meio ambiente e sustentabilidade da empresa.

  • Coordenar o trabalho de forma segura e ambientalmente responsável.
  • Desenvolver e manter a implementação eficaz da política de SSMA da empresa.
  • Fornecer aconselhamento e suporte de SSMA para Operações e Projetos da Karoon, implementar os pressupostos, políticas e padrões de SSMA da Karoon nas atividades operacionais e preparando documentos para suporte técnico.
  • Realizar auditorias regulatórias conforme cronograma desenvolvido (ANP, IBAMA, Marinha, etc.).
  • Revisar relatórios de auditoria e inspeção interna de SSMA em campo onshore/offshore e atuar em processos de auditoria relacionados a órgãos fiscais e reguladores.
  • Participar de discussões e fóruns do IBP com associações da indústria sobre atividades que provoquem (ou possam provocar) mudanças regulatórias.
  • Apoiar a Política de SSMA, Regras de Ouro e Campanhas de SSMA nas operações onshore e offshore.
  • Embarque esporádico conforme necessidade de monitoramento de atividades e processos de SSMA offshore.
  • Apoiar a equipe de Meio Ambiente e participar das seguintes atividades sempre que necessário, como assistência na implementação de programas de emergência e socioambientais necessários, apoio em auditorias ambientais internas e externas offshore e licenciamento ambiental para contratados.
  • Auxiliar na diligência prévia ambiental.
  • Avaliar a documentação ambiental dos ativos.
  • Identificar passivos ambientais e reportar à gestão com recomendações.

*Vaga onshore (com eventuais embarques offshore – por demanda específica).

  • Graduação completa em Engenharia (de Produção, Química, Mecânica, Ambiental ou áreas correlatas). É necessário pós graduação em Engenharia de Segurança.
  • Pós graduação em Engenharia Ambiental é desejável.
  • Certificação de Auditor Líder para Sistemas de Gestão (ISO 45001, ISO 14001)é desejável.
  • Fluência em Inglês e Português - falado e escrito.
  • Boas habilidades de apresentação.
  • Bom conhecimento no Pacote Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Power BI).
  • 15 anos ou mais de experiência no setor de SSMA no mercado de Óleo e Gás (experiência com FPSO é um diferencial).
  • Experiência comprovada em investigações de incidentes (métodos como Fault Tree, Ishikawa, ICAM, TapRooT, etc.).
  • Sólido conhecimento de regulações de segurança operacional da ANP e padrões IMO.
  • Conhecimento técnico de metodologias de análise de riscos.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas digitais de SSMA é desejável.
  • Ambiente multicultural de colaboração e desenvolvimento – trabalhe com profissionais de diferentes origens e culturas, promovendo aprendizado contínuo e crescimento profissional.
  • Cultura baseada em valores – nossa atuação é guiada por princípios de respeito, integridade e compromisso com a excelência.
  • Remuneração e benefícios competitivos – oferecemos um pacote de remuneração alinhado ao mercado, incluindo benefícios atrativos para o seu bem-estar e qualidade de vida.
Nós somos a Karoon Energy Brasil, seja muito bem-vindo(a)!

A Karoon Energy é uma empresa internacional de exploração e produção de petróleo e gás natural, com projetos no Brasil, no Golfo do México e na Austrália, com ações listadas na bolsa de valores da Austrália.

A companhia detém e opera 100% do Campo de Baúna , localizado ao sul da Bacia de Santos, que compreende os reservatórios de Baúna, Piracaba e Patola. A companhia também detém os campos de Neon e Goiá , e o bloco S-M-1537, todos ao sul da Bacia de Santos .

No Golfo da América , a companhia tem uma participação não-operacional de 30% nos campos de petróleo e gás Who Dat e Dome Patrol, 16% no campo Abilene, assim como variadas participações em infraestrutura na área de exploração na costa da Louisiana (EUA).

Nossa visão é ser uma companhia líder e independente de energia, capaz de se adaptar a um mundo dinâmico de maneira inovadora e empreendedora. Nosso propósito é fornecer energia de forma segura, responsável, criando benefícios duradouros para todos os seus stakeholders.

Overview

Project Kuiper is an initiative to launch a constellation of Low Earth Orbit satellites that will provide low-latency, high-speed broadband connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the world. Amazon Kuiper is seeking an experienced, self-motivated Sales Professional to lead the adoption of Amazon Kuiper broadband and related services with maritime and offshore partners and end users in Brazil. This role is a unique opportunity to build and execute our sales pipeline with major offshore operators, service contractors, and merchant marine customers. The ideal candidate has a strong track record in selling to, managing, and supporting large Energy sector clients, with maritime experience preferred. Knowledge of agriculture, OEM, and aviation industries is a plus. A solid understanding of satellite communications, experience working with global remote teams, and the ability to manage complex, long-term deals from start to finish are essential. You will be responsible for growing maritime and mobility opportunities in Brazil, managing both direct and channel engagements. This includes working with local partners to establish infrastructure that supports high-value contracts and leading cross-functional teams to deliver on customer and partner initiatives. Strong relationship skills and fluency in English and Portuguese are required.

Please note: This role may involve access to information or technology subject to U.S. export control regulations (EAR/ITAR). Employment is contingent on obtaining any necessary licenses or approvals from the U.S. government, based on eligibility under these regulations.

Key job responsibilities
  • Contribute to the build out of Amazon Kuiper service revenue with specific focus on Mobility partners and end users.
  • Be customer obsessed. Think on behalf of the customer and work to meet the customer’s stated and unstated needs and aspirations
  • Execute strategic and tactical business development initiatives while working with key internal stakeholders (e.g., Amazon Kuiper product and engineering teams, legal, finance) and BD team colleagues.
  • Be the internal coordinator supporting complex contract negotiations and complex business requirements and activities which deliver results.
  • Adept at thinking strategically and analytically about business priorities, product, and technical challenges, with the ability to deliver target based results working cross-organizationally.
  • Excellent written and verbal communications including a passion for writing detailed strategic documents and a preference for a second fluent spoken language.
  • Consistently exceeds key performance metrics and delivers results.
  • Experience driving consensus across multiple internal and external stakeholders.
  • Must be able to articulate business value & technical approach.
A day in the life

Kuiper's Sales strategy and Go To Market plan is well defined and yet each working day is different from the next. The satellite Mobility sector is global and our customer engagements take us around the world whether on video calls on supporting face to face engagements. We may start the day with a customer call with Australia and finish the day with a channel partner meeting in Austin. Taking time during a busy day to evaluate critical data points and develop strategies and tactics is important. As is the process of codifying these decisions and their outcomes.

About the team

Here at Amazon, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. Amazon has ten employee-led affinity groups, reaching 40,000 employees in over 190 chapters globally. We have innovative benefit offerings, and host annual and ongoing learning experiences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 16 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious and earn trust. Experience with Oil and Gas customers. Fluent in Portuguese. Bsc or Msc in telecommunications. MBA. Understanding of regulatory landscape and import tax in Brazil.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. Overview

Primary Care Physician - BC Family Medicine at Community Health Centers of the Central Coast, Inc. (CHC). Reports To: Chief Medical Officer. FLSA Status: Exempt. Wage Range: $9,230.77 - $11,220.06 bi-weekly.

Summary: Under the direction of the Chief Medical Officer, but with independent responsibility for professional results, the Physician provides primary healthcare services for CHC and performs related work as required. CHC aims to provide the highest quality of total care to the patient population; employees are expected to be professional, punctual, maintain regular attendance, cooperative, organized, and enthusiastic.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities
  • Secure and evaluate a patient''s health history and record findings in a systematic, accurate, and succinct manner.
  • Perform physical assessments and discriminate between normal and abnormal findings.
  • Provide routine physical examinations, diagnostic services, and treatment of illnesses and emergencies.
  • Adhere to high ethical standards and assure quality of care for all patients.
  • Share on-call duties with other medical staff as indicated.
  • Elicit and record information about patient medical history; examine patients to determine general physical condition.
  • Order or execute tests, analyses, and diagnostic images; analyze reports and findings to diagnose conditions.
  • Administer or prescribe treatments and drugs; inoculate and vaccinate patients; advise on diet, hygiene, and disease prevention.
  • Report births, deaths, and outbreaks to governmental authorities; refer patients to specialists when needed.
  • Perform minor surgeries and conduct physicals for school admissions, job considerations, or insurance eligibility.
  • Assist the Chief Medical Officer in establishing medical policies and education programs; participate in care coordination and policy development as required.
  • Share supervisory responsibilities of the nurse practitioner with the Clinical Director as required; work within privileges and protocols established by the CMO.
  • Participate in committees as requested; adhere to safety and infection control policies; provide age-appropriate care across patient populations.
  • Maintain HIPAA-compliant, confidential communications; participate in patient population management with cultural sensitivity and appropriate local resources.
  • Coordinate with the Care Team to arrange appropriate services and support patient goals; contribute to quality improvement using evidence-based practices.
Supervisory Responsibilities

May supervise mid-level providers at the direction of the Chief Medical Officer.

Qualifications
  • Education: Medical Doctor (M.D.) or Doctor of Osteopathy (D.O.) from an accredited medical school.
  • Residency: Completion in Family Practice, Internal Medicine, OB/GYN, or Pediatrics; board certified or board eligible.
  • Licenses and Certifications: Current, unrestricted Physician and Surgeon license in California; current DEA license; ACLS for FP/IM; PALS for Pediatrics; BLS (all specialties).
  • Continuing education: Maintains current knowledge through CME and participation in relevant medical societies.
  • Language Skills: English required; Spanish bilingual desirable.
Education And/or Experience

As listed under Qualifications above.

Other Requirements
  • Ability to perform essential duties and accommodate reasonable accommodations as needed.
  • Physical demands and work environment as described below may apply: willing to work flexible hours, occasional travel to other clinic sites.

description:
Imagine your career taking you to the depths of innovation and the heights of impact. Our people enable continuous progress. Their commitment, collective expertise, and unique capabilities are the engine room behind SBM Offshore’s True. Blue. Transition. - shaping the future of energy, and beyond.

About Us:

SBM Offshore is the world’s deepwater ocean‑infrastructure expert. Our work is already resulting in cleaner, more efficient energy production. True. Blue. Transition. is our promise to enable that into the future while at the same time using our expertise to support new and existing markets in the blue economy. It starts with Advancing our Core: continuing to advance the decarbonization of traditional energy production. While Pioneering More: helping to enable the energy transition and using our unique capabilities in ocean infrastructure to support more industries to grow sustainably. Sharing our experience for a better blue tomorrow.

  • As Subject Matter Expert on Sustainability (ESG), for your discipline and assigned Projects/Operations Readiness, you are responsible for ensuring prevention and mitigation of risks to our personnel, assets, the environment and our Company reputation, and for ensuring compliance with all standards, rules and other requirements imposed by Company, Regulators, Clients and other relevant Stakeholders.
Responsibilities
  • You support the Management in driving the education, communication, and implementation of the ESG management system as part of the execution phase.
  • You support SBM Group in developing a robust suite of ESG & Sustainability-related management systems in line with international standards and guidelines for project execution.
  • You ensure the collection, analysis, and reporting on ESG & Sustainability topics.
  • You are the focal point for your discipline on Social topics, both internally in support of our Turnkey Projects, Operation Readiness, and externally to the clients, contractors, and vendors.
  • You complete pre-tender human rights audits of major subcontractors.
  • You review potential subcontractor bid technical evaluations for compliance with project social requirements.
  • You lead Social assessments/studies in liaison with the Project Manager to ensure the correct integration of such into the project.
  • You manage all social initiatives on the project in conjunction with Clients throughout the project execution.
  • You contribute to the project progress report concerning all social activities in liaison with Group Sustainability and support emissions data collection for the project.
  • You lead the activities related to your discipline to provide effective support to Projects and/or Operation Readiness as necessary.
  • You prepare, implement, and update the Social and Emissions aspects of the HSSE Plans/Project Execution Plans.
  • You implement and monitor the Social and Emissions aspects management system, plans, and procedures.
  • You provide ESG & Sustainability practices and policy training to appropriate site, warehouse, laboratory, and office personnel, ensuring relevant employees and contractors receive appropriate training.
  • You may act as a Social Performance/Human Rights SME (Subject Matter Expert) for external stakeholders.
Education
  • Master’s Degree in Environment, Sustainability, Engineering, Business or equivalent
Experience
  • Experience in HSSE, Social Performance & Sustainability • Project Management skills • Knowledge Compliance and international laws.
  • Experience in designing and implementing successful programs, campaigns and initiatives.

At Dover Fueling Solutions (DFS), we are taking fueling and convenience retail to the next level. We are passionate about cultivating excellence in everything we do, but what really fuels us is our people. They’re the heart of our company. As an employee, our promise to you is that you’ll work on new and innovative products and solutions, be mentored by managers and teammates who are collaborative, caring, and act with integrity, and have the opportunity to grow in ways that are meaningful to you. Unique and interesting projects – both locally and globally – will challenge you and allow you to pursue different and rewarding career paths.

We are #EnergizedByGrowth.

DFS is part of a legacy of leadership that spans back generations, made up of some of the most trusted, leading-edge brands in the industry. As part of Dover Corporation and with our talented, innovative, outstanding people, we are doing great things and redefining what is possible in fueling and convenience retail. Providing advanced fuel-dispensing equipment, including clean energy solutions, systems and payment, automatic tank gauging and wet stock-management solutions, DFS comprises the product brands of Wayne Fueling Systems, OPW Fuel Management Systems, ClearView, Tokheim, ProGauge, Fairbanks, LIQAL, AvaLAN, and Bulloch Technologies. Headquartered in Austin, TX, DFS has a significant technology development and manufacturing presence worldwide, including facilities in Brazil, China, India, Italy, Poland, the Netherlands, the United Kingdom and the United States.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Responsible for checking the accuracy of import/export recordkeeping.
  • Manage, request, and compile necessary import documentation to ensure entry accuracy.
  • Partner with different teams like sales and customer services teams on due diligence process, including but not limited to Know your customer, screening, and vetting.
  • Support local entity’s participation on FTA (Free trade agreement) under the guidance from Corp. compliance and partner with functional teams on the necessary supporting calculation and collection.
  • Partner with Engineering to ensure accurate Harmonized Tariff classifications, maintain internal classification databases and ensure accuracy of customs entries.
  • Assist in maintaining part databases with global trade compliance data including product classifications, HTS Codes, and country of origin classifications.
  • Audit Import entry data and manage any Post Entry Amendment requirements with the broker.
  • Coordinate audits to ensure import/export policies are followed and identify necessary corrective action plans to continuous improvement.
  • Monitoring program including broker review, post entry etc.
  • Manage the proper reporting of assists as related to Dover trade compliance policy.
  • Provide training with the support from corporate compliance team to local entities on different trade compliance topic.
  • General compliance support, including VC (screening tool), TPG (3rd party vetting platform), code of conduct, conflict of interest, training etc.
  • Other duties pertaining to corporate compliance as assigned.

Qualifications/Experience Requirements

  • Additional experience in supply chain, traffic, logistics, business is highly desired.
  • Strong interpersonal skills, with a positive, team-oriented approach.
  • Ability to assess risk and recommend actions and strategies to mitigate regulatory risks.
  • Self-starter with the ability to work independently on multiple tasks to meet deadlines, prioritize, and maintain flexibility in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
  • Experience in tariff classification and country of origin determination. Engineering background in HTS Classification is a plus.
  • Strong understanding of documentation requirements and Brazil Customs regulations.
  • Data analysis and Excel skills proficiency.
  • Brazil Customs Brokerage License not required, but highly desirable.
  • Impeccable ethics and trustworthiness.

Work Arrangement : Hybrid

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

Our mission is to build a next-generation private cloud infrastructure, combining KVM, Ceph, and SDN technologies to create a data center scale cloud that 'just works' and provides a mission-critical cloud for edge and core enterprise deployments. We're hiring engineering managers with experience in high-quality microservice architectures and high-performance team leadership who also have deep familiarity with Linux kernel, virtualisation, storage and networking.

LXD components span the entire software stack from low-level kernel features to the upper level management API/CLI. Our most effective engineers are fluent in all these layers, and able to anticipate the consequences of design and engineering choices elsewhere in a complex distributed system.

As an engineering manager at Canonical you must have a solid technical background, but your responsibility is to run an effective team and develop the colleagues you manage. You are expected to help them grow as engineers, do important work, do it outstandingly well, find professional and personal satisfaction, and work well with colleagues and the community. Technical leadership experience and a background in software engineering are necessary prerequisites for this role. You will be expected to lead, challenge, and develop engineers, positively influence the culture, facilitate technical delivery, and work with your team on strategy and execution.

The successful candidate will have experience leading successful, collaborative engineering teams, and demonstrate the ability to solve challenging distributed systems problems and deep knowledge of Linux.

Location : This is a remote position available in EMEA and the Americas.

  • Lead a team of remote engineers
  • Develop talent through coaching, mentoring, feedback and hands-on career development
  • Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams, senior management, and external stakeholders

  • You love developing and growing people and have a strong track record of doing it
  • You are focused on success and the delivery of timely, high quality software
  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
  • You have strong written and verbal technical communication skills
  • You have experience programming in C and/or Go.

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year

  • Recognition rewards

  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme

  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

How your day-to-day work will look like

Design, implement, and maintain observability pipelines across the three main signals—logs, metrics, and traces—ensuring standardized, scalable, and efficient data ingestion. Optimize ingestion strategies to balance cost, performance, and usability.

Build self-service automation and tooling that enables development teams to instrument and leverage observability without requiring manual intervention from the SRE team. Drive adoption of best practices while ensuring teams own their telemetry.

Design the processes, playbooks, checklists, and automations for them and other engineers to follow during an incident.

Leverage Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) to provision and manage monitoring tools, alerting rules, and our observability configurations across OTEL Pipelines.

Design base-level requirements for new and existing services to ensure that all client infrastructure and code are monitored consistently and accurately at a basic level.

Take full ownership of client infrastructure reliability, ensuring adherence to key availability and security KPIs.

This would make you the ideal candidate

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

8+ Years of experience working as an SRE Engineer or in a very similar role, more focused on observability.

5+ Years of experience working with cloud (AWS).

4+ Years of experience working in Kubernetes, including its core components, deployment methodologies, and monitoring best practices.

Strong communication skills with team members and stakeholders (technical and nontechnical communication).

Strong scripting abilities (Python, Go, or similar) for automating observability tasks.

Experience integrating incident management platforms (PagerDuty, Jira) with automated alerting workflows.

Join to apply for the Software Engineering Manager, Ubuntu Gaming role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1100+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing.

As the Software Engineering Manager for Ubuntu Gaming, your mission is to help make gaming on Ubuntu first-class. In this exciting time for Linux gaming, compatibility tools like Proton have matured, but a well-rounded gaming experience goes beyond compatibility. It entails maximising performance, robust and secure anti-cheat mechanisms, full device support, and ease of content creation, sharing and discovery. By collaborating with open-source projects and other partners, you'll contribute to not just Ubuntu but the wider Linux gaming ecosystem.

Location: This role will be based remotely in the Americas or EMEA region.

The role entails

  • Leading your team in optimising and expanding the Ubuntu gaming experience, focusing on the Steam Snap.
  • Managing project timelines, balancing feature improvements with deadlines.
  • Collaborating with stakeholders to align your team's work with other teams and company objectives.
  • Conducting keen-eyed code reviews, focusing on quality, performance, and modern design principles.
  • Collaborating with upstream projects like Proton and partners like Unity to enhance Ubuntu's gaming capabilities.
  • Working closely with other teams to ensure a cohesive and comprehensive Ubuntu experience.
  • Driving performance improvements across a wide range of hardware.
  • Engaging actively with the open source and gaming community to gather feedback and collaborate on improvements.

What we are looking for in you

  • An undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path.
  • Proven ability to collaborate effectively with upstream projects and partners.
  • Familiarity and experience with the Linux graphics stack spanning user-space components to low level kernel drivers.
  • Exceptional software project management skills, encompassing risk assessment and resource allocation.
  • Ability to balance technical leadership with effective team management.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills for both internal and external interactions.
  • Robust planning skills, demonstrated by your capacity to manage multi-cycle improvements.
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long

Nice-to-have skills

  • A passion for technology and gaming, driving you to work with intelligent, motivated colleagues.
  • Initiative in proactively identifying opportunities and solving challenges.
  • Curiosity, flexibility, and a strong sense of accountability.
  • A focus on soft skills, including passion, enterprise, and self-motivation.

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year

  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Join to apply for the Software-Defined Networking Engineer role at Canonical

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

This is a general selection process for all seniority levels, to join teams that focus on open source networking software at Canonical. Apply here if you are an outstanding software engineer, passionate about networking at any level - from the Linux kernel IP or eBPF and bridge constructs, to overlay SDN networking like OVS and OVN, to router, switch and radio access technologies such as SoNIC, FRR and DENT, all the way up to telco MANO and 5G Core solutions.

We work with networking silicon providers to optimise Ubuntu and related applications for their ASICs, boards and appliances. We aim to provide a complete open source stack for data centre networking, from bare metal through virt, container and serverless, and also to address IoT networking systematically.

If you have a passion for networking technologies, deep familiarity with Linux networking and awareness of open source community best practices, then you will enjoy our software-defined networking role at Canonical. We look for excellent academic results and a commitment to quality, resilience, documentation and performance in your work.

At Canonical you will have the opportunity to engage with the broader open-source community and industry leading partners in developing future-proof networking solutions. We're looking for individuals who can help build a thriving community, contribute to a broad range of technologies, and contribute to the deployment of Ubuntu, Ubuntu Core, OpenStack, LXD, MAAS and MicroK8s across a broad range of devices and use cases.

These roles include:

  • Kernel Networking Software Engineer
  • OVN Software Engineer
  • SmartNIC Software Engineer
  • Top-of-Rack (ToR) Software Engineer
  • SoNIC or DENT Software Engineer
  • Telco Software Engineer
  • Kubernetes Software Engineer

Location: we have networking software engineering roles in every time zone

What your day will look like

  • Work with the most advanced operating systems and network application technologies available
  • Collaborate with public clouds and network silicon providers
  • Design and implement the best software-defined networking experience for the latest hardware platforms and software stacks
  • Write high-quality, well-designed and well-documented software
  • Contribute to shape innovative product strategies
  • Debug issues and produce high-quality code to fix them
  • Collaborate proactively with a globally distributed organisation
  • Contribute to technical documentation to make it the best of its kind
  • Display technical leadership internally, towards our partners, and in the open source communities
  • Influence open-source projects and communities
  • Shape software-define networking products for evolving data centre architectures to meet ever-increasing bandwidth, reliability, security, and interoperability demands
  • Work from home, with global travel twice a year for company events of up to two weeks duration

What we are looking for in you

  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Knowledge of networking: architecture, design, and protocols
  • Deep understanding of Linux networking, from kernel to user space
  • Fluency in at least one of Golang, C/C++, Rust or Python
  • Professional written and spoken English
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Passion, thoughtfulness, and self-motivation
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks each

Additional Skills That You Might Also Bring

  • Familiarity with existing open source networking technologies - kernel (including eBPF, AF_XDP), OVS, OVN, SoNIC, DENT, Switchdev, DPDK, SPDK, 5G 3GPP, ONF stack, iwd, NetworkManager, etc.
  • Familiarity with data path hardware acceleration protocols and interfaces, such as RDMA, RoCE, iWARP, NVMe, SR-IOV
  • Computer architecture knowledge of x86, ARM, and RISC-V
  • Experience in complex IP network engineering and implementation
  • Experience with virtualization technologies, e.g., QEMU, KVM, etc.
  • Previous contribution to open source projects and community involvement
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes, Cloud-native Network Functions, and Container Network Interface plugins
  • Performance engineering and security experience

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

The role of a Customer Success Manager at Canonical

Customer success is a new and strategic department at Canonical, with the objective to reduce risk and churn, facilitate the adoption of new products or services and support expansion within existing accounts. Customer Success Managers (CSM) are responsible for developing trust with their assigned customers and providing them with the best possible experience navigating Canonical's vast offering. Through a clear understanding of their customer's objectives, the CSM can activate a large range of internal and external capabilities to alleviate any pain point, align expectations, as well as help draw and deliver on an appropriate collaboration roadmap.

We are growing our Customer Success team to continue offering thoughtful, smart, precise interactions across our product portfolio, from Ubuntu to open source infrastructure and applications.

This role is a first step in the CSM organisation. Although you will primarily focus on the Tech segment, including the store customers, you will also have a portfolio assigned. Ubuntu is chosen by thousands of new users every month. Our responsibility is to ensure the best user experience for them through problem-solving, onboarding, enablement and value realisation all the way to success. Collaborating with other teams and participating in campaign efforts, you will connect with a diverse set of users of Canonical products and identify our future champions.

Location: This role will be based remotely worldwide.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include top public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders across sectors. The company pioneers global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and few office-based roles. Teams meet a few times a year in various interesting locations worldwide to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring a Public Cloud Project Manager . This role requires customer relationship management and advocacy for Canonical's technical assets. It offers an opportunity for technologists passionate about Linux and Project Management to build a career with Canonical. Ideal candidates have a software affinity, strong communication skills, and a passion for technology, and will work with some of the best industry professionals.

Public Cloud Project Managers lead accounts and provide insight for Canonical's key Tier 1 Enterprise Public Cloud clients. They collaborate across teams from Software Engineering to Senior Executives.

As a Public Cloud Project Manager, you will oversee multiple major projects simultaneously. You will shape Statements of Work (SoW) with clients, manage project lifecycles, and ensure goals for both Canonical and clients are achieved.

International travel may be required, varying in amount and duration based on project needs.

Location: This role is remote within the Americas region.

The role entails:

  1. Ensuring projects are delivered on time, within scope, budget, and resources
  2. Identifying and mitigating project risks and issues
  3. Maintaining strong customer focus and working with stakeholders for successful outcomes
  4. Conducting regular status meetings and reviews with clients
  5. Managing delivery schedules of third-party contributions
  6. Handling cross-organizational engineering requests outside existing contracts
  7. Promoting Canonical technologies to clients

What we are looking for:

  • Proven experience in the IT Cloud industry as a project manager, Scrum Master, or similar role
  • Deep knowledge of Linux, open source, and public cloud environments
  • Software engineering background
  • Excellent English communication skills
  • Experience managing remote, cross-cultural teams and clients
  • Strong negotiation and influencing abilities
  • Bachelor's degree in a STEM field
  • Project Management Certification (PMP or equivalent)
  • Agile Certification (Scrum Master or equivalent)
  • Willingness to travel domestically and internationally

What we offer colleagues:

  • Distributed work environment with biannual in-person team sprints
  • USD 2,000 annual learning and development budget
  • Annual pay reviews and performance bonuses
  • Additional benefits reflecting our values and local needs
  • Recognition rewards, holiday leave, parental leave
  • Wellness programs and travel opportunities

About Canonical:

Canonical is a pioneering open source tech company, publisher of Ubuntu, and a leader in AI, IoT, and cloud platforms. We recruit globally and uphold high standards of excellence. Most employees work remotely, fostering a flexible, innovative work environment since 2004.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer, committed to diversity and fairness in hiring and workplace practices.

title: Danielle Bibas é nomeada CEO da Pierre Fabre
description:
Com longo histórico na Avon e passagem de um ano pelo Grupo Petrópolis executiva substitui Ana Paula Magri. Danielle Bibas acaba de assumir o cargo de chief executive officer (CEO) da filial brasileira da companhia francesa Pierre Fabre, sediada no Rio de Janeiro.

Ela substitui Ana Paula Magri, que havia sido a primeira pessoa brasileira a ocupar o comando da empresa no País.

Com isso, Danielle estará à frente do negócio que, no Brasil, comercializa as marcas Eau Thermal Avène (marca francesa especializada em dermocosméticos e uma das líderes em venda na Europa), Ducray (também francesa e focada em alta ciência e medicalização) e Darrow Laboratório (marca brasileira de dermocosméticos para pele oleosa e que, segundo a empresa faz sucesso entre a GenZ e começou a ser exportada para outros países da América Latina recentemente).

Danielle trabalhou como CMO do Grupo Petrópolis de setembro de 2022 a setembro de 2023, mas antes disso teve um longo histórico na Avon.

Na companhia de beleza, onde trabalhou por 12 anos, ocupou os cargos de CMO no Brasil e vice-presidente de marketing global. Imediatamente antes da Avon, também teve um histórico de 16 anos na P&G, onde também lidou com a categoria de saúde e beleza, tendo seu último cargo por lá sido o de presidente de Health and Beauty Care, no Canadá.

Metas estabelecidas

Há dois anos, a filial brasileira da Pierre Fabre – cujo faturamento global gira em torno de € 2,8 bilhões – ocupava a 10ª posição no mapa da companhia. E a então CEO, Ana Paula, afirmava que o objetivo era que o Brasil subisse cinco posições nesse ranking, dobrando o tamanho dos negócios até 2026.

Na cidade de Areal, no Rio de Janeiro, está instalada a única fábrica da Pierre Fabre fora da França. E desde 2018 o País também abriga o Brazilian Innovation Center (BIC), focado no desenvolvimento de produtos para a população local.

description:
Overview

(Rio de Janeiro) Gerente Paula Cotrim | Vendas - Seguros de Vida e Previdência (Autônomo - Atuação Presencial)

Descrição da vaga: Quer redirecionar sua carreira profissional, aprender uma nova profissão e iniciar seu próprio negócio? Venha atuar como Corretor de Vida e Previdência na MAG Seguros! Você ingressará no nosso Programa para Formação de Novos Corretores, onde aprenderá tudo sobre Seguro de Vida e Previdência. Realizará o curso preparatório para o exame de Habilitação Técnico Profissional e, ao ser aprovado, terá sua licença para atuar como Corretor de Seguros, começando o seu próprio negócio, com todo o suporte e expertise da MAG Seguros.

Responsabilidades e atribuições
  • Você atuará como profissional autônomo com as seguintes atribuições:
  • Inicialmente, se dedicará exclusivamente ao curso preparatório da MAG Universidade para obtenção da habilitação técnico profissional junto a Susep;
  • Após a conquista da Habilitação:
  • Identificará potenciais clientes para abordar, utilizando sua Rede de Relacionamento para agendamento de entrevistas de vendas e solicitação de indicações;
  • Fará telemarketing ativo para agendar entrevistas de vendas;
  • Realizará as entrevistas de vendas, identificando as necessidades de proteção financeira do prospect e ofertando as soluções mais adequadas a cada perfil;
  • Gerenciará a sua carteira de clientes com foco na sustentabilidade financeira do seu negócio.
Requisitos e qualificações
  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Aptidão para vendas;
  • Amplo círculo social (network/ rede de relacionamento);
  • Perfil ativo nas redes sociais;
Você se diferenciará
  • Experiência como profissional autônomo, liberal ou empreendedor;
  • Experiência com venda consultiva e rotina de vendas externas.
Informações adicionais
  • PESSOAS BEM-SUCEDIDAS NESSA PROFISSÃO: São aguerridas, motivadas, resilientes e persistentes, dedicando à construção do sucesso de seu próprio negócio;
  • Identificam-se com o propósito de despertar nas pessoas o desejo e a necessidade de assegurar o próprio futuro e o das pessoas que amam;
  • Possuem ampla rede de relacionamento, frequentam grupos sociais ligados a esporte, religião, hobbies, culinária, educação, negócios ou qualquer outro tema que permita estar em contato frequente com diferentes pessoas, ampliando o círculo social;
  • Possuem como prioridades o sucesso profissional e os ganhos financeiros, independente de regime de contratação de trabalho;
  • Têm disponibilidade para atuar conforme agenda do cliente, possuindo flexibilidade na rotina de trabalho, para atendimento além dos horários convencionais;
  • Atuam com disciplina no planejamento semanal das atividades de vendas, de acordo com os parâmetros necessários para o atingimento e superação dos objetivos financeiros e pessoais;
  • Dedicam-se ao estudo contínuo em busca de novos conhecimentos, mantendo-se atualizadas profissionalmente.

Já pensou em redirecionar sua carreira ou aprender uma nova profissão? Agora imagine só, poder fazer isso sendo parceiro de uma empresa que, há quase 200 anos, ajuda as pessoas a planejar um futuro financeiro mais tranquilo. Aqui na MAG, nossos corretores parceiros são chamados de Especialistas em Proteção Financeira. E se você tem tino comercial, gosta de se relacionar com pessoas, tem perfil empreendedor e deseja trabalhar com o forte propósito de prover soluções financeiras individuais nos diversos momentos de vida de todos os brasileiros, nosso Programa para Formação de Especialistas em Proteção Financeira é a oportunidade ideal para você!

Sabemos bem que um processo de mudança de carreira pode ser algo difícil. Mas, participando de nosso Programa, você terá todo o suporte necessário para ser bem sucedido, desde o treinamento em sala de aula - onde aprenderá mais sobre a empresa, seu portfólio e o processo de vendas – até o acompanhamento em campo, onde realizará - com a supervisão de nossos líderes especialistas - as primeiras entrevistas de vendas.

Conheça as vantagens de se tornar Especialistas em Proteção Financeira parceiro da MAG Seguros
  • Além de toda estrutura de suporte, treinamento e acompanhamento, poderemos apoiá-lo financeiramente na fase inicial de constituição de seu negócio, mediante o atingimento de critérios mínimos de produtividade.
  • Subsídios de até 70% para adquirir produtos como plano de saúde, de telefonia móvel, seguros de vida, notebook e smartphone, mediante elegibilidade ao nosso Programa de Fidelidade
  • Comissionamento vitalício sobre grande parte das coberturas comercializadas, ou seja, a comissão é do corretor pelo tempo em que o contrato do cliente estiver ativo, permitindo ganhos ilimitados.
  • Atuação presencial, com relacionamento multicanal, que pode ser realizado via unidades de vendas, telefone, WhatsApp, e-mail e chat, além de portal exclusivo para corretores.
  • Campanhas de vendas periódicas, que premiam os vencedores, além do reconhecimento e distinção, com incríveis viagens de turismo ou de desenvolvimento. Acesse vida.mag.com.br/mag-365.
  • Conversão das vendas em pontos que podem ser trocados por mais de 50 mil itens disponíveis em um catálogo virtual.

Sobre a MAG: Com mais de 6 milhões de clientes e cerca de R$ 475 bilhões assegurados, somos especialistas no desenvolvimento de soluções personalizadas em seguros de vida e planos de previdência individuais e corporativos. Em 2009, nos associamos ao Grupo Aegon, presente em mais de 20 países ao redor do mundo. Hoje, somos a terceira maior seguradora independente do Brasil e contamos com 38 unidades de vendas físicas espalhadas pelo Brasil, que servem de base para o trabalho de mais de seis mil corretores parceiros.

description:
Overview

Conservation International protects nature for the benefit of humanity. Through science, policy, fieldwork, and finance, we spotlight and secure the most important places in nature for the climate, biodiversity, and for people. With offices in 30 countries and projects in more than 100 countries, Conservation International partners with governments, companies, civil society, Indigenous peoples, and local communities to help people and nature thrive together.

Position Summary

This position is based in Arlington-VA (hybrid), Bogota-Colombia (hybrid) or Brazil (fully remote). This position is responsible for the administration of CI’s financial accounting systems: Unit4 Business World and Concur. The Financial Applications Director ensures optimal use of these systems and their related applications and plays a leading role in the integration of these systems with other CI databases relating to financial data and processes. This role also provides training to users, maintains security, and troubleshoots application issues for both US and field-based staff.

Responsibilities
  • Systems Support
  • Responsible for all aspects of end-user support for financial systems, including:
    • Hands-on resolution of tickets, including documentation in the ticketing system and communication with affected staff and IT stakeholders.
    • Communication with software vendors for issues that cannot be resolved internally.
    • Management of other support staff and coordination with business process owners and other team members as needed to resolve tickets.
    • Oversee creation, maintenance, and termination of user accounts in financial systems. Conduct periodic security audits as required.
    • Create and manage complex workflow processes for appropriate systems, including troubleshooting and maintenance.
    • Design special-purpose reports and processes utilizing SQL Server, Business World reporting tools, or other tools as required for audits or other management uses. This includes Business World AG16’s (SQL-based customizations). Manage design, test, and maintain custom reports and forms in Business World using ARC (Agresso Report Creator). This includes complex reports such as the check and the purchase order form.
    • Create and maintain security roles for both menu and reporting (data) access.
  • System Maintenance, Enhancements, and Vendor Management
  • Ensure financial systems are up to date and used to maximum effect:
  • Lead or participate in identifying system improvements, modifications, and enhancements that will streamline processes, increase efficiency, and provide needed functionality.
  • Develop and maintain interfaces to other systems as needed.
  • Serve as the Business World applications ‘go-to’ person by researching software functionality, staying current on technology changes, and advising on best practices.
  • Test patches to ensure that they resolve issues as intended. Work with systems software vendors and CI’s IT department to facilitate the migration of patches to production that have passed testing. Create/maintain system configuration as needed to ensure optimal processing.
  • Maintain and manage relationships with financial systems, software, and service vendors to ensure strong working relationships, maximized levels of support, and efficient use of CI’s resources.
  • Documentation and Training
  • Develop and maintain financial systems SharePoint resource site(s) with relevant help materials for end users.
  • Draft and update financial systems user and administrative procedures as needed.
  • Conduct training for end users as required.
  • Project Management/Change Management
  • Manage financial systems team meetings. Coordinate with business process owners, super users, and other team members as needed to ensure good communication on all financial system-related issues.
  • Manage the change management system to ensure all changes to production financial systems are properly documented, approved, tested, and implemented.

Other duties as assigned by the supervisor.

Working Conditions
  • Normal office environment.
  • Guidance on flexible work arrangements will be shared during the interview process.
Qualifications Required
  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field.
  • 7 or more years of related experience.
  • 2 or more years of supervisory experience.
  • Strong knowledge of Financial Applications, including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Contract Accounting, Operating Budget, Project Management, and Procurement modules.
  • Solid working knowledge of database architecture and management
  • SQL Server and Visual Basic experience
  • Experience with ERP reporting tools
  • Project management skills.
  • Ability to adapt and work effectively with functional teams across the organization.
  • Understanding of accounting processes and standards.
  • Experience in training on software applications.
  • Preferred
  • Administrator experience using Unit4 Business World
  • Fluency in Spanish, Portuguese, Indonesian, and/or French
